privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Your data stays on this device
privacy.localBody: Trackers, entries, notes, reminders and preferences are stored only on this device. Foxiem has no account and no server, and your history is never uploaded.
privacy.notificationsBody: Reminders are scheduled locally on this device. Foxiem asks for permission only when you turn a reminder on.
privacy.analyticsBody: Foxiem sends a few anonymous events to Google Analytics for Firebase, such as that a tracker was created and which kind. Tracker names, notes, counts and history are never sent.
privacy.exportBody: Export everything as CSV from Settings at any time. Reset Foxiem removes all of it from this device.

about.title: About
about.description: Foxiem is a personal count and progress tracker. Count anything in a tap and see how it changes over time.
about.licensesBody: Foxiem is built with React Native, Expo and other open-source software. Typefaces: Bricolage Grotesque and Figtree, both under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Icons: Ionicons and Material Design Icons.

reset.title: Reset Foxiem?
reset.body:
This permanently removes every tracker, entry, note, reminder and preference from this device. It can't be undone.

A subscription is not cancelled by resetting.

errors.boundaryBody: Foxiem hit an unexpected problem. Your data is stored on this device and hasn't been removed.
